scene.ko: 함께 한 수업이 끝난 뒤 잘된 점과 아쉬운 점을 돌아보고, 원어민 교사의 솔직한 의견을 들은 뒤 다음 수업 역할을 다시 나눈다.

lines.en: So, how do you think the lesson went today?
lines.ko: 그래서 오늘 수업 어땠던 것 같아요?

lines.en: Overall, I think it went well. The students really enjoyed the role-play at the end.
lines.ko: 전체적으로 잘된 것 같아요. 학생들이 마지막 역할극을 정말 재미있어했어요.
alt: I think it went well overall. The kids loved the role-play at the end.

lines.en: I agree. But the instructions for the main activity took too long. I think some kids got lost.
lines.ko: 저도 그렇게 생각해요. 그런데 본 활동 설명이 너무 길었어요. 몇몇 아이들은 놓친 것 같아요.

lines.en: You're right. Maybe next time we could show a quick example first instead of just explaining.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 다음에는 설명만 하지 말고 먼저 짧게 시범을 보여 주면 어떨까요?
alt: Good point. Next time, maybe we can model it first instead of explaining so much.

lines.en: Good idea. Can I be honest about one more thing?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 하나 더 솔직하게 말씀드려도 될까요?

lines.en: Of course. I'd really like to hear your thoughts.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 선생님 생각을 꼭 듣고 싶어요.
alt: Sure. Please tell me what you think.
Of course. I want to hear it.

lines.en: You translated a lot of my sentences into Korean. I know you want to help, but the students stopped listening to me.
lines.ko: 제가 하는 말을 한국어로 많이 옮겨 주셨잖아요. 도와주시려는 건 아는데, 그러다 보니 학생들이 제 말은 안 듣게 되더라고요.

lines.en: Hmm, I hadn't noticed that. Thanks for telling me. How about I only translate when students look really confused?
lines.ko: 음, 그건 미처 몰랐네요. 말씀해 주셔서 고마워요. 학생들이 정말 헷갈려할 때만 통역하면 어떨까요?
alt: I didn't realize that. Thank you for being honest. What if I translate only when they're really lost?

lines.en: That sounds perfect. And maybe you could walk around and help the groups that are struggling.
lines.ko: 그거 딱 좋네요. 그리고 돌아다니면서 어려워하는 모둠을 도와주시면 좋겠어요.

lines.en: Sure. So next time, you'll give the instructions, and I'll help the groups. Let's try it on Thursday.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그럼 다음에는 선생님이 설명을 맡고 저는 모둠을 도울게요. 목요일에 해 봐요.
alt: Okay. Next time, you explain the activity and I'll support the groups. Let's try that on Thursday.

expressions.en: Overall, I think it went well.
I hadn't noticed that. Thanks for telling me.
expressions.ko: 그건 미처 몰랐네요. 말씀해 주셔서 고마워요.
